Student feedback of Teaching process and Actions taken 

  • The Feedback about the teaching process is taken during and at the end of each semester.  
  • Lecture classes are monitored by the Head of the Department and constructive comments are given to improve the quality of teaching and the teaching-learning process. 
  • At end of semester, the students will give feedback on the following traits shown in fig.1.  
  • Head of the department conveys remedial measures to be taken by the faculty member for the observations on lecture classes. 
  • Faculty members are informed to attend training programme on teaching pedagogy.
